terminalRaceCoverage: Independent held-source and held-capacity cases check that a delayed original request cannot revive an identical submission after terminal full-window rejection, even after ordinary cancellation frees the target. Earlier14 run changed source mid-run and is not final acceptance.
priorHarnessReturn: independent-first.json retained one incorrect recovery selector (#gate); actual UI uses #portalRecovery. The corrected selector changes no runtime behavior.
scope: Independent actual owner client handler, transaction module and fully intercepted actual browser assets. Synthetic memory store only. Fault-only ESM wrappers preserve actual store/CAS/queue implementations and throw at explicitly named boundaries; no application source changes.

checks.name: Owner create rejects anonymous, foreign-session, operator-purpose and foreign/missing-Origin writes
Create validates required values, strict callback phone, real date, listed future window and input schema before persistence
Create, move and cancel update exact records, slot capacity, history and local notification queues without delivery claims
A full or blocked destination keeps original record and capacity unchanged
Immutable replay succeeds after stale record/configuration while a changed payload or fresh conflicting submission is rejected
Lost booking-CAS and capacity-finalization replies recover same operation without duplicate history/capacity
Queue projection failure preserves local save and GET recovery before the exact retry finishes preparation
Same-slug replacement cannot expose or mutate the former incarnation visit
An aborted create fences a delayed CAS but is absent from owner records and managed notification discovery
Lost abort-fence reply recovers exact abort and restores capacity without showing a fabricated visit
Concurrent creates cannot exceed one window and conflicting move operations preserve the first exact mutation
A delayed source or capacity phase cannot revive an operation already terminally rejected by an identical retry
Rejected Add and move operations recover a failed lock release through GET and exact retry before a new action
Ordinary owner UI shows field errors and completes add/move/cancel with honest delivery status
Focused invalid callback field and its linked error keep visible red error styling
Lost UI response and page reload recover the original submission without another create
Sign-out during an already-committed held response clears private UI and ignores late completion

limits: All records, mailboxes, callback numbers and sessions are synthetic; no outbound provider/model/email/Calendar action was performed.
Fault-only ESM wrappers throw around actual conditional-store and queue calls; no production source or algorithms are replaced.
Held-response sign-out is triggered through its actual click listener programmatically because a busy modal correctly prevents pointer access to background navigation.
No live multi-instance storage, customer consent, delivery or deployment is established.
